programme.title: I Saw the Devil
programme.desc: Soo-hyun is determined to track down the murderer of his late wife even if it means becoming a monster.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Lyon Gaultier, a member of the French Foreign Legion who deserts his post in order to come to America and help the family of his murdered brother. But crossing the U.S. without a penny to his name proves difficult. Lyon then takes up the sport of bare-knuckle fighting, earning him the money to reach his destination and support his loved ones -- but with the Foreign Legion hot on his trail, will he ever find peace?

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: Night Moves
programme.desc: Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.

programme.title: Prime Orbit
programme.desc: When Earth is facing imminent collision with an asteroid, Manuel must survive a last resort automated space program to save the planet in hopes of reuniting with his brother.

programme.title: Point B
programme.desc: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.

programme.title: Exile
programme.desc: After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.

programme.title: Listening
programme.desc: Grad students invent mind-reading technology that destroys their lives and threatens the future of free will itself.

programme.title: Day of the Comet
programme.desc: The summer of 1986. Halley’s comet races around the earth for the first time in 76 years. Three losers in a small town, believing that what they are seeing is your run-of-the-mill shooting star, each make a wish for a better life. But when their wishes are granted too literally, the neighborhood plunges into total chaos.

programme.title: Alien Reptilian Legacy
programme.desc: Researchers reveal the presence of a supreme interdimensional intelligence that has been manipulating mankind for centuries. Interviews with experiencers and alien abductees expose a sinister agenda behind the alien presence on Earth.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: Titan
programme.desc: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the main stage of the Mission Cronos. Orpheus, one of the astronauts who has descended to its surface, is searching for organic life forms. This is his story.

programme.title: Bravestorm
programme.desc: In the year 2050 mankind is extinct. The last survivors travel back in time to stop the invader, the Killgis, in a battle of giant robots.

programme.title: Final Voyage
programme.desc: Two men on the run encounter an old abandoned spaceship in the desert. They escape their pursuers into space and set off in search of a new home.

programme.title: Tangent Room
programme.desc: Trapped in a room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: Police Story: Lockdown
programme.desc: The highly-anticipated fifth installment of the Police Story franchise, starring Jackie Chan in a story of family ties, betrayal, and revenge.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra.

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris record Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 & 10
programme.desc: Quatuor Ébène marks the 250th birth anniversary of Beethoven with a project.

programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Los 800
programme.desc: En 1937, 800 soldados chinos luchan bajo asedio desde un almacén en medio del campo de batalla de Shanghai, completamente rodeado por el ejército japonés.

programme.title: Lobo Guerrero 2
programme.desc: Secuela de la película de acción exitosa Wolf Warrior (2015) La operación más peligrosa de las fuerzas especiales de China se instala en una vida tranquila en el mar. Cuando los mercenarios sádicos comienzan a atacar a civiles cercanos, él debe dejar atrás su nueva paz y volver a sus deberes como soldado y protector.

programme.title: Lucha por la Libertad
programme.desc: Una historia real ambientada en contra de la Guerra Civil y la Reconstrucción. La historia sigue a Newton Knight, un opositor Sureño que huyó del campo de batalla y reúne desertores del ejército confederado para su llamada Compañía del Caballero contra la Confederación. Knight se casó con la ex esclava de su abuelo y sigue siendo una figura que causa discrepancias en la actualidad.

programme.title: La Orden Judicial
programme.desc: Tras luchar en la Guerra Civil, dos compañeros de la Unión se encuentran en lados opuestos poniendo en peligro la paz de posguerra.

programme.title: Ip Man – El Maestro del Kung Fu
programme.desc: Finales de la década de 1940, provincia de Foshan. Justo antes de la Revolución Comunista, el legendario maestro de artes marciales Ip Man trabaja como capitán en la policía local y está siendo acusado de la muerte de un gángster local. En busca de venganza, la hija del criminal procede a perseguir a Ip Man. Para evitar más problemas, el capitán decide dejar la policía. Ahí es cuando las fuerzas armadas japonesas invaden China y comienzan a dominar la región.

programme.title: Guardianes
programme.desc: Un guardaespaldas tiene la tarea de proteger a la hija de un importante científico para que la investigación de su empresa no caiga en las manos equivocadas. Cuando aparezca un grupo de mercenarios para robar el material, tendrás que luchar para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Justicia Máxima: Vivir es Luchar
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a la hija de su comandante, un equipo de soldados de élite vuelve a entrar en acción. La misión de localizar a la hija hace que el equipo sacrifique sus vidas para descubrir la verdad, salvarla y hacer justicia.

programme.title: El Duelo Final
programme.desc: Una luchadora que dejó los ring se ve forzada a volver a la activa cuando su hermana, que entró en el mundo de las luchas ilegales, tiene su vida amenazada por el dueño del torneo, un hombre sádico y capaz de todo.

programme.title: Atrapada En Guantánamo
programme.desc: Uma jovem americana se alista no exército com a intenção de lutar no Iraque e escapar de sua cidade natal. No entanto, ela acaba designada como guarda no campo de detenção da Baía de Guantánamo, bem longe dos combates. Cercada por jihadistas hostis e colegas agressivos, ela inicia uma amizade incomum com um dos detentos.

programme.title: Invasores de Tumbas
programme.desc: Con promesas de tesoros incalculables, dos aventureros modernos se unen para entrar en la antigua tumba de Quin Shi Haung y evitar que un loco libere el mercurio atrapado en su interior.

programme.title: Lockhart: Liberando el Talisman
programme.desc: La vida normal de un hombre da un vuelco cuando hereda un antiguo artefacto de cristal y se convierte en "la clave" para liberar al mundo del dominio de la esclavitud energética y del Gobierno Mundial Único clandestino. Después de un intenso y peligroso trabajo de detective, Jon Lockhart descubre que la familia Lockhart ha estado ocultando el cristal, también conocido como "El Corazón", de los malvados Illuminati durante los últimos 1.000 años, desde la época de Robert the Bruce y las Cruzadas. El Corazón de Cristal contiene un código científico que puede generar suficiente energía limpia e ilimitada para alimentar al mundo entero. Ahora Jon debe encontrar una manera de proteger el secreto de su familia y el futuro suministro de energía manteniendo el Corazón de Cristal a salvo de la élite "Illuminati", que no se detendrá ante nada para encontrar el corazón y finalmente controlar el suministro de energía del mundo para siempre.

programme.title: Cabeza Hueca
programme.desc: Tras contraer una gran deuda con un líder criminal local, Eddie Sullivan necesita ganar mucho dinero rápidamente y para ello enlista a un amable gigante llamado Walter (superestrella de la WWE).

programme.title: El Último Sharknado: Ya Era Hora
programme.desc: Decidido a devolverle la vida a su familia, Gil envía a su padre Fin atrás en el tiempo para detener el inicio de los Sharknados. En el camino, lucha contra dinosaurios, caballeros, vaqueros y una versión robótica de su esposa. Esta vez, no se trata de cómo detener los Sharknados, sino de cuándo.

programme.title: El Último Vikingo
programme.desc: Un joven vikingo llega a Gran Bretaña buscando aventuras, pero deberá sobrevivir cuando su clan es asesinado.

programme.title: Hitman - El Rey de Asesinos
programme.desc: Un exjefe de la mafia japonesa es sospechoso de ser víctima de un ataque y deja una recompensa para quien encuentre a su asesino. Entonces, un asesino a sueldo y un estafador deciden juntos buscar al enigmático "Rey de los Asesinos" y ganar el codiciado premio.

programme.title: Fuerza Letal
programme.desc: El comando Karan Singh Dogra y la inspectora Bhavna Reddy compiten contra el tiempo para frustrar un ataque terrorista. Sin embargo, pronto se dan cuenta de que descifrar la conspiración del autor intelectual Buraq podría ser más difícil de lo que imaginaban.

programme.title: Dejados Atrás La Película
programme.desc: Cuando todos los creyentes desaparecen del planeta un reportero quedará para ver al Anticristo tomar el poder.

programme.title: El Cazador y el Libro Mágico
programme.desc: Un legendario cazador de demonios interpretado por Jackie Chan investiga las desapariciones de las jóvenes de un pueblo. Cuando descubre que fuerzas malignas están secuestrando a las niñas para darse un festín con sus almas, se propone salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: El Hechicero Y La Serpiente Blanca
programme.desc: Un monje maestro intenta proteger a un joven e ingenuo médico de un demonio serpiente milenario. Una competencia de poderes psíquicos desata el caos.

programme.title: Venganza al Trono
programme.desc: Una epopeya de espadas y brujería ambientada a finales del siglo XIII en Malta. Un grupo de guerreros maltrechos topa con un fuerte después de una sangrienta batalla. Los acontecimientos rápidamente se convierten en un torbellino de intriga, sexo y brutales enfrentamientos medievales.

programme.title: El Encargo
programme.desc: Jack es contratado por Dragna, un jefe del crimen, para cumplir con una tarea aparentemente inocente: tiene que llevar un bolso a un motel en Nueva Orleans y esperar que lo pasen a retirar. Pero nunca Jack podrá abrir el bolso. Pero en el momento en que pone un pie en el motel su vida está en juego, varios criminales intentan sacarle el bolso y Jack tiene que defenderlo si quiere vivir

programme.title: Apartamento 212 - La Infestación
programme.desc: Jennifer Conrad es una chica de pueblo buscando un comienzo en la gran ciudad. Huyendo de una relación abusiva, todo lo que quiere es una oportunidad para comenzar de nuevo. Pero es difícil comenzar de nuevo cuando algo te consume mientras duermes.

programme.title: Mentes Malvadas
programme.desc: Película de episodios, en la que se exploran mitos, cultura y folklore desde el punto de vista de varios directores internacionales de cine fantástico y de terror.

programme.title: Líbranos de Todo Mal
programme.desc: Lilith, la reina del submundo, regresa a la Tierra para vengarse de la humanidad. Expulsa del jardín del Edén por rehusarse a obedecer a Adán, Lilith finalmente tiene la oportunidad de exterminar a todo su linaje cuando se ve cara a cara con el único hombre capaz de detenerla, el hijo único de un pastor, descendiente directo de Adán.

programme.title: Catástrofe inminente
programme.desc: Un gran planeta errante ha arrojado a la Tierra fuera de su órbita. Lanzada por el espacio, la Tierra está causando una gran devastación. La única oportunidad de los supervivientes es que la fuerza del Sol recupere el control de la Tierra pero, aunque lo haga, la vida en el planeta habrá cambiado para siempre.

programme.title: Los Asesinatos en la Cabaña de Utah
programme.desc: Dos hermanas luchan por sobrevivir cuando unos intrusos enmascarados invaden su cabaña de vacaciones.

programme.title: Crepitus - El Payaso Caníbal
programme.desc: Elizabeth, de 17 años, y su hermana menor, Sam, dejan a su madre alcohólica y maltratadora para vivir en la casa de su abuelo fallecido. Pero no esperaban que su nueva vida fuera aún más aterradora. Después de descubrir que su familia tuvo un pasado aterrador y que han ocurrido cosas terribles en la casa, Elizabeth y Sam son perseguidas por un payaso caníbal llamado Crepitus.

programme.title: Siempre observando: una historia Marble Hornet
programme.desc: El equipo de noticias de una pequeña ciudad descubre una caja de cintas de vídeo en las que una figura sin rostro, vestida con un traje oscuro, acecha y atormenta a una familia... volviéndola lentamente loca. Poco después, se dan cuenta de que el "Operador" también ha empezado a acecharlos a ellos.

programme.title: El Aro 2
programme.desc: Reiko esconde a Yôichi cuando su hijo comienza a mostrar poderes aterradores. Mientras tanto, Mai Takano y las autoridades comienzan una búsqueda desesperada por ellos, mientras se propaga la misteriosa maldición del Anillo.

programme.title: Viaje para el Infierno
programme.desc: Lo que comienza como las vacaciones de la vida de un grupo de jóvenes turistas estadounidenses se convierte rápidamente en una lucha por la supervivencia cuando descubren la tienda abandonada. Cazados uno por uno por una amenaza desconocida, deben luchar y aprender a trabajar juntos si esperan sobrevivir esta noche. Rápidamente se dan cuenta de que en África más oscura, deben aprender a no confiar en nadie, temer lo inesperado y descubrir este siniestro secreto. El viaje termina aquí!

programme.title: La Sirena Asesina
programme.desc: Cuando dos amigas se encuentran con el escondite de una sirena en el interior de una fortaleza abandonada, lo que se suponía que serían unas tranquilas vacaciones, se convierte en una sangrienta lucha por la supervivencia.

programme.title: Presencias del más allá
programme.desc: Después de más de cien años de servicio, The Yankee Pedlar Inn cierra sus puertas para siempre. Los últimos empleados restantes, Claire y Luke, están decididos a descubrir pruebas de lo que muchos creen que es uno de los hoteles más embrujados de Nueva Inglaterra. A medida que se acercan los últimos días del Inn, huéspedes extraños se registran mientras el par de "cazadores de fantasmas" con salario mínimo comienzan a experimentar eventos extraños y alarmantes.

programme.title: Te Seguiré en la Oscuridad
programme.desc: Una joven deprimida tras la muerte de sus padres se encierra en sí misma, pero un romance inesperado con un hombre llamado Adam la saca de su depresión. Después de que Adam desaparece misteriosamente en las profundidades de un edificio de apartamentos embrujado, ella promete buscarlo, incluso si eso significa cruzar al mundo de lo sobrenatural.

programme.title: Secretos Malignos
programme.desc: Mientras vuelve a casa tras una cita obstétrica, Esther es brutalmente atacada y desfigurada por un asaltante encapuchado. Este terrible evento parece ser una bendición disfrazada cuando Esther encuentra consuelo en un grupo de apoyo. Su vida de tristeza y soledad se abre a la amistad, la empatía e incluso la aceptación. Sin embargo, la amistad y la empatía pueden ser muy peligrosas cuando involucran a las personas equivocadas.

programme.title: Sombra del Terror
programme.desc: Stan, el adolescente inadaptado, vive con su abuelo abusivo y trata de proteger a su mejor amigo de los matones de la escuela secundaria. Cuando descubre que una criatura asesina se ha refugiado dentro de su cobertizo de herramientas, intenta luchar contra el demonio solo hasta que su amigo descubre a la criatura y elabora un plan mucho más siniestro para acabar con los enemigos de su escuela.

programme.title: Somnia: Antes de despertar
programme.desc: Jessie e Mark decidem adotar Cody, um menino que tem pavor de dormir. Inicialmente, eles acreditam que a fobia se origina do passado traumático do garoto. Mas logo descobrem a verdade: os sonhos de Cody são projetados na realidade, e muitas vezes o que se materializa são pesadelos horríveis e mortais.

programme.title: El Atrapa Sueños

programme.title: Pena de Muerte
programme.desc: Death Penalty es un documental sobre la serie de crímenes más emocionante registrada en la historia de Chile. Un grupo de asesinos psicópatas cometió asesinatos que aterrorizó a todo un país. La historia refleja la evolución de una mente criminal que se desarrolló y se manifestó durante el gobierno militar en los años 80.

programme.title: Los Cazarrecompensas
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite comienza cuando nos encontramos con la asociación de cazarrecompensas de No Name (Northup) y Dynamite Davenport (Ting), quienes siguen su propio camino para recolectar las recompensas, pero se ayudan mutuamente cuando se trata de las recompensas más desafiantes.

programme.title: Huida Desesperada
programme.desc: Después de un trabajo bancario fallido, una pandilla toma como rehén a una niña japonesa que huye de un matrimonio arreglado y escapa.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un escuadrón de soldados del ejército estadounidense es enviado a una misión detrás de las líneas para localizar a su oficial de mando desaparecido.

programme.title: Traición conyugal
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que su marido no es el hombre que ella creyo conocer, Cathy Coulter es acusada de un asesinato que no cometio. Para salvar la vida de su hijo, y la suya propia, Cathy debe escapar de la justicia... y su unica salida es encontrar al verdadero asesino, antes que este los encuentre primero.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Una adolescente debe defenderse y proteger a su familia cuando un grupo de convictos violentos invade su casa de vacaciones.

programme.title: Dos pistolas de leyenda
programme.desc: En el anárquico Oeste, los Cowboys, una tristemente célebre hermandad de asesinos y ladrones, gobernaban con puños y pistolas. El destino finalmente los ha alcanzado, y ahora la despiadada banda solo tiene un miembro superviviente.

programme.title: El Niño De Barro
programme.desc: Buenos Aires, 1912. Una serie de asesinatos a menores se propaga por la ciudad. Mateo, un nino de 10 anos, esconde un secreto: a veces su mente le conduce a un lugar de la memoria en donde es testigo de los asesinatos. Al descubrirse su secreto muchos creerán que es el asesino. Estela, su madre, con el apoyo del forense de la policía trata de encontrar una explicación a las visiones.

programme.title: Faust, La Venganza Está En La Sangre
programme.desc: Un hombre vende su alma al diablo para obtener superpoderes y vengar la brutal muerte de su novia. Al darse cuenta de que el precio es el alma de su nuevo interés amoroso, se vuelve contra el diablo.

programme.title: El misterio de God´s Pocket
programme.desc: El alocado hijastro de Mickey, Leon, muere en un "accidente" de construcción y Mickey, rápidamente, trata de olvidar esta fatalidad intentando enterrar el cuerpo. Pero cuando un columnista local llega para husmear y descubrir la verdad, las cosas empiezan a ir de mal en peor. Mickey se encuentra atrapado en una lucha con un cuerpo inerte al que no puede enterrar, una esposa que es incapaz de complacer y una deuda que nunca podrá pagar.

programme.title: La Cara del diablo
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes viaja a la selva de Tarapoto esperando encontrar mucha diversión

programme.title: McCanick
programme.desc: A lo largo de un día, un detective de narcóticos persigue a un joven delincuente aparentemente inofensivo que conoce una verdad sobre el pasado del policía.

programme.title: Ríos de Sangre
programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de un juez afroamericano es asesinado en una parada de rutina que sale mal, el juez Charles Coleman toma la justicia en sus propias manos para asegurarse de que se haga justicia cuando los dos policías salgan libres.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane entra en una prestigiosa universidad con una beca de deporte y enseguida hace migas con Brandon, su rico compañero de habitación. Brandon le presenta a su familia y Shane se hace ilusiones de que pertenece a ella. Cuando Brandon lo deja de lado porque ha conocido una chica, las cosas se complican y Brandon acaba muerto. Shane se presenta en la casa de Brandon y lo que empieza como una atracción irresistible con la madre de Brandon se acaba convirtiendo en una obsesión hasta el punto que planea matar al marido para quedarse con todo."

programme.title: Nunca Hables Con Extraños
programme.desc: Sarah Taylor, una psicóloga criminalista, conoce en un supermercado a Tony Ramírez (Banderas), un misterioso e irresistible hombre hispano que la seduce y la enamora. Pero cuando la relación empieza a torcerse, ella decide contratar a un investigador privado para que siga a su amante.

programme.title: El código del asesino
programme.desc: Un detective novato, hijo de un policía caído en desgracia, trabaja para resolver su primer caso importante bajo la atenta mirada de un asesino fantasmal.

programme.title: Historia de una traición
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, Mildred Gillars, conocida como “Axis Sally”, es obligada por los nazis a emitir propaganda para soldados estadounidenses durante la II Guerra Mundial. Tras su relación con Goebbels y su posterior arresto, es juzgada por traición con la ayuda de su abogado defensor.

programme.title: Sed de venganza
programme.desc: Nick Brenner intenta dejar atrás su pasado violento, pero la mafia para la que trabajaba regresa por venganza. Le arrebatan lo que más ama: su esposa. Con ayuda del sheriff local, que además es su suegro, Nick se ve obligado a decidir entre mantener su nueva vida o desatar una sangrienta venganza contra sus enemigos.

programme.title: Comandante General
programme.desc: Un especialista en comando militares es contratado por un multimillonario de Hong Kong para armar un grupo despiadado que tendrá una única misión: eliminar a los criminales más peligrosos y notorios del mundo.

programme.title: El Amor Mata
programme.desc: Frank es un asesino a sueldo que trabaja para un gran sindicato del crimen de Estiria. Cuando recibe el encargo de secuestrar a una chica llamada Marlene y entregársela al sindicato, todo cambia para él. Se enamora de ella y desobedece las órdenes de sus superiores, que deciden realizar la tarea por su cuenta. Frank tendrá que luchar contra los sicarios del sindicato para salvar a su amada.

programme.title: Underworld: Guerras De Sangre
programme.desc: El distribuidor de muerte de vampiros Selene evita ataques brutales del clan Lycan y la facción de vampiros que la traicionó.

programme.title: Legión
programme.desc: Dios ha perdido la fe en el ser humano, así que ha decidido enviar a su legión de ángeles a la Tierra para exterminar a la raza humana por segunda vez en la Historia. La única esperanza recae sobre un grupo de rebeldes escondidos en mitad del desierto, que recibirán la ayuda del mismísimo arcángel Miguel...

programme.title: The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes náufragos crecen aislados en una isla paradisíaca y descubren el amor.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: De noche, Britt Reid , heredero del gran imperio periodístico creado por su padre, se convierte en un héroe enmascarado que se propone combatir el crimen: es The Green Hornet. Su compañero de aventuras es Kato , un experto en artes marciales.

programme.title: Soy Espia
programme.desc: La superestrella Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) se une a Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) en un emocionante viaje cargado de acción. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) también aparece como una agente secreta supersexy. Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.

programme.title: Seguridad Nacional
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence protagoniza esta comedia divertida y llena de acción interpretando a Earl Montgomery, un cadete del Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles algo gallito que probablemente sería un policía extraordinario si no fuera tan fanfarrón. La rebelde actitud de Earl hace que le echen de la academia de policía y tiene que aceptar un empleo como humilde guarda de seguridad en “National Security.

programme.title: Los Otros Dos
programme.desc: Ambientada en Nueva York, la cinta sigue al detective Allen Gamble, un contable forense más interesado en el papeleo que en recorrer las calles, y al detective Terry Hoitz, que ha trabajado con Allen como compañero desde su confrontación con Derek Jeter.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hollywood
programme.desc: Érase una vez... en Hollywood de Quentin Tarantino, nos traslada a Los Ángeles de 1969, donde todo está cambiando, y donde la estrella de la televisión Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio), y Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt), su doble desde hace muchos años, se abren camino en una industria que ya prácticamente no reconocen. La novena película del célebre escritor y director cuenta con amplio reparto y múltiples tramas argumentales que rinden un tributo a los momentos finales de la época dorada de Hollywood.

programme.title: The Raid 2: Berandal
programme.desc: Poco después de finalizar la sangrienta redada, el inspector Rama se ve obligado a infiltrarse en las filas del sindicato del crimen de Yakarta con el fin de proteger a su familia y descubrir la corrupción en el seno de su propia fuerza policial.

programme.title: Christine
programme.desc: La retorcida historia de amor de un adolescente y su celoso Plymouth Fury modelo 58.

programme.title: Armados y Peligrosos
programme.desc: Los ganadores de los Premios Emmy John Candy y Eugene Levy arremeten contra el mundo de la seguridad privada pero, por desgracia, ¡normalmente van en dirección equivocada! Cuando el torpe policía Frank Dooley (Candy) y el inepto abogado Norman Kane (Levy) pierden sus trabajos, comienzan a trabajar en la Guard Dog Security Company, donde los robos se producen justo debajo de sus narices.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta; Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

programme.title: El Arte De Robar
programme.desc: Crunch Calhoun, un acróbata motociclista de tercera, y ladrón de arte en sus ratos libres, se junta con su escurridizo hermano para robar uno de los libros más valiosos del mundo. Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe; una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. Sólo Carnegie (Gary Oldman), un autoproclamado jefe militar que gobierna una ciudad de ladrones y pistoleros, conoce el poder que Eli tiene en sus manos y ha decidido arrebatárselo. Pero nada puede interponerse en el camino de Eli. Nada puede impedirle cumplir con su destino y ayudar a un mundo arruinado.

programme.title: Bienvenidos A Zombieland
programme.desc: El empollón universitario Columbus (Jessie Eisenberg) y el apasionado de las armas y de los bollos Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) están a punto de enfrentarse a su reto más terrorífico: estar juntos. Emma Stone y Abigail Breslin coprotagonizan esta comedia de golpes dobles y cabezas reventadas.

programme.title: Zombieland: Mata Y Remata
programme.desc: Diez años después de que Zombieland se convirtiera en un gran éxito, el reparto principal (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Abigail Breslin y Emma Stone) se reúne de nuevo en Zombieland: Mata y remata. En esta secuela, cargada de la locura y diversión que les caracteriza, estos 4 supervivientes viajarán desde la Casa Blanca al corazón del país, luchando contra nuevos tipos de zombis que han evolucionado desde la primera película, y encontrando nuevos supervivientes humanos. Pero por encima de todo, se tendrán que enfrentar a los problemas de su alocada e improvisada familia.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: La vida de Mary (Taraji P. Henson) , una asesina a suelto de la mafia de Boston, da un vuelco inesperado cuando conoce a un niño que despierta el instinto maternal que creía perdido.

programme.title: No Respires 2
programme.desc: Un pasado violento alcanza a un hombre ciego que debe luchar una vez más por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: El Sicario de Dios
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Stealth
programme.desc: Un escuadrón de pilotos de élite se embarca en una peligrosa misión. Intentan neutralizar un prototipo de avión de combate que está fuera de control y que dispone de un sistema de inteligencia artificial cuyas acciones podrían desencadenar una guerra nuclear.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Ambientada en una sociedad futura, en la que la mayor parte de los niños son concebidos in vitro y con técnicas de selección genética.

programme.title: Mandíbulas

programme.title: Los Cazafantasmas
programme.desc: Un trío de parapsicólogos universitarios pierde su subsidio de investigación y decide abrir su propio negocio, "Ghostbusters", y casi de inmediato son convocados para investigar los extraños sucesos en un departamento de Central Park West. Lo que descubren es que toda Manhattan está siendo asediada por otros demonios mundanos.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: Sunka Raku: Alegría Evanescente
programme.desc: Roberto un famoso músico y publicista vive en una casa de té japonesa cerca de la Ciudad de México.

programme.title: Desde las gradas, Pelé
programme.desc: Pelé era un prodigio que jugaba con la "ginga", una visión única y un control de balón inimaginable.

programme.title: Vigilante Diaries
programme.desc: Un equipo de agentes de operaciones secretas convertido en justicieros está liderado por un antihéroe conocido como 'El Vigilante'. Sus misiones de rescate y venganza van desde las mansiones de Los Ángeles hasta lugares como Irak, Armenia, Rusia y el Reino Unido.

programme.title: Black Rose
programme.desc: El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles contrata a un comandante de la policía rusa para ayudar a resolver una serie de horribles asesinatos perpetrados contra mujeres jóvenes por un sádico asesino sociópata en las calles de Hollywood.

programme.title: Abanderados
programme.desc: Un documental sobre leyendas olímpicas

programme.title: Cut Off
programme.desc: Un médico forense descubre un mensaje en el cuerpo de una víctima que lo lleva a una carrera contrarreloj para salvar a su hija secuestrada.
